Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Annexure B PART III: Special Terms & Conditions SCOPE OF WORK: Dismantling & removal of old gearbox and erection of cement mill new gearbox M/s. NAW make and its alignment with mill and auxiliaries at C CI Rajban site. Approximate weight of gearbox is 20 MT. 1) Unloading of new gearbox at Cement mill site from Trolla with Hydr a/cranes after arrival at CCI site. 2) Dismantling of existing torsion shaft. 3) Dismantling of lubricating pumps of FLS along with its pipelines. 4) Removal of existing gearbox from foundation and shifting to site as decided by in-charge and cleaning of foundation for any removal of oil and foreign materials.

5) Removal of input shaft both end couplings and output couplings of existing gearbox. 6) Shifting of input and output shaft couplings to cement mill site, shif ting of oil drums, coal, container for heating and its arrangement for shrink fitting of couplings over new gearbox. 7) Fitting of input shaft both end couplings and output shaft coupling on new gear box after heating in oil. 8) Shifting and erection of new gearbox to cement mill gearbox found ation. 9) Alignment of gearbox w.r.t to mill Girth gear pinion, HT motor and a uxiliary drive gearbox. 10) Erection and fitting of lubricating pumps and pipe lines and filling of lubricant in Gearbox. 11) Connecting input coupling with HT motor. 12) No load trial run of gearbox. 13) Fitting of torsion shaft. 14) No load trial run of gearbox with empty mill. 15) Load trial run of gearbox. 16) All other works like hiring of cranes/hydra, shifting of sleeper, coupl ings, loading-unloading of spares etc. will be in tenderer scope. 17) Any dismantling required to be carryout for successful execution of work and erection of the same will be considered as scope of work. 18) The replaced gearbox to be shifted to secure site as instructed by t he in-charge. 1) Quantity:- 01 Nos 2) Eligibility criteria:- The tenderer should satisfy the following eligibility criteria for qualifying t he techno-commercial bid of the tender and should provide the documen ts as mentioned hereunder. S. No. Minimum eligibility criteria Proof to be submitted for fulfilli ng the criteria

1 The tenderer should have 5 y a) The party has to submit ears experience of similar nat document proof of the s ure job i.e., dismantling & ere ame. ction of single machinery of 2 0 MT& above. (3) Prices:- The rates should be quoted in prescribed price bid format in Indian Curren cy i.e. INR only as per the Price Bid format (Annexure-F) enclosed. Prices quoted other than INR will be rejected outright. a) Price should be quoted on FIRM and FOR destination basis including Tran sportation, GST, insurance and other charges, if any (to be specified clearly) and strictly as per the given price bid format. The price quoted shall remain firm duri ng the contract period or extension thereof and no revision will be permitted due to whatsoever reason it may be. b) The Basic Rate inclusive of Freight charges are to be offered in numerals and GST are to be offered in percentage. c) The Lowest Bidder (L-1) shall be evaluated on the basis of net cost to the corporation i.e. Total landed cost of the items inclusive of overhauling& c ommissioning charges &labour charges but excluding the input credits fr om GST ( applicable on basic rate, erection & commissioning charges & fr eight.) (5) Period of contract:- The above mentioned dismantling, erection, alignment and commissioning work etc. should be completed within 15 days from the date of handing over the mill to you.. (6) Payment Terms :- 90% Payment shall be made through RTGS/NEFT after satisfactory completion of the work and trial run in presence of our engineer and on production of bill in du plicate within 30 days after deduction of TDS under IT Act and GST and other de duction if any. Balance 10% which is retained towards performance guarantee ( PG), shall be released after satisfactory running for 60 days. However, this balan ce amount (10%) can be released in case the Bank Guarantee for equivalent am ount is submitted as per the format.

(7) Mode of Payment:- The Payment will be released/Made through RTGS/NEFT. (8) Penalty/ liquidated Damage :- In the event of delay in carrying out the work at over site beyond the scheduled period as agreed, shall attract liquidated damage @ 0.5% per fortnight on the t otal value of work subject to maximum of 5% of the contract value. (9) Security Deposit.:- Successful tenderer (s) shall have to furnish a Security Deposit within 07 days fr om the award of LOI/Order equivalent to 5% (Five percent) value of the order by way of Demand Draft/Bank Guarantee (IN CCI’s format) in terms of Clause No. 2 of Part-II of the tender documents for satisfactory completion/ performance of th e contract. S.D will be refunded within 2 months of successful completion of wor k. (10) Paying Authority :- HOD (Finance) CCI Rajban:- ANNEXURE-C CEMENT CORPORATION OF INDIA LIMITED RAJBAN CEMENT FACTORY PART IV - OTHER TERMS& CONDITIONS 1) Site Visit: The parties are expected to see the site of work, condition of cement mill gearbox, for assessment of spares required & labour for carryi ng out the work as per scope of work given above before submitting offer. No claim what so ever shall be entertained by the Corporation later on aft er submission of the tender.

2) Tools & Tackles: a. The party at his own cost shall arrange all tools and tackles required for taking up the jobs as per scope of work given above. A list of tools is required to submit at the CCI Main gate to facilitate return of the same after satisfactory completio n of the work by the party. The spares to be brought by the party are also needs to be got entered at the Main gate. b. All other works like hiring of cranes/hydra, shifting of sleeper, couplings, l oading- unloading for above works etc. will be in tenderer scope. c. The required tools & tackles for dismantling of couplings and alignment works (wooden sleepers, filled gas cylinder, welding machine, oil and oil p an for heating the bearings will be provided by CCI at free of cost. d. However, welding cable, hydraulic Jack, chain blocks, slings, D-shackles, grinding &drilling machines, general lifter tools, torque wrench, gas hose, cutter and regulator will be in the scope of contractor) torsion shaft, loadin g, unloading of gearboxes, alignment work tools etc. are to be arranged by the successful tenderer. e. All tools related to alignment work for gearbox with motor, girth gear pinion, mill, auxiliary gearbox etc. will be at scope of tender er. Party has to conduct Laser alignment from outside agency as well for confirmation of alignment and submit its report. 3) Any dismantling required to be carryout for execution of work or rectifica tion, the damages occurred to any equipment shall be in the scope of the contractor. 4) All the safety Rules and Regulations should be followed strictly such as w earing of helmets, safety belts etc. Safety equipment’s/items, masks, sanit izer, gloves, soap, safety shoes shall have to be arranged by the contract or. 5) Statutory levies of income tax or any other tax etc. if any shall be recovered a t source by way of deduction from the bill, if applicable. 6) The tenderers having PAN card, GST registration number and ESI code n umber under ESI act 1948 are only eligible to participate in the tender. 7) The tenderer is required to submit the photocopies of PAN card, ESI cod e no,EPF no and GST registration number. a. No labour below 18 years of age to be allowed in the plant. b. Payment to the workforce not to be less than min. wages of HP Sta te Govt. c. Employment card on form XIV (U/V 76) issued to all labours on or before allowing the labours work. d. The tenderer has to also submit Aadhar card of labours. 9) Accommodation to the workforce engaged by the contractor is to be pro vided by corporation subjected to availability. However, accommodation may be provided to Site Engineer subject to availability and on chargeable basis.

10) The quality of the work should be as per the relevant standard and to th e entire satisfaction of Engineer-in-Charge. In case of any defects pointed out should be rectified expeditiously without any additional cost to the Cor poration so as to complete the job within the stipulated schedule of 15day s from the date of handing over the mill to you. 11) In the event of any question, dispute, breach or difference arising in resp ect of the meaning and scope of terms & conditions herein above, the deci sion of the General Manager will be final and binding to all and in case of a ny dispute with the decision of General Manager, Rajban Unit, it will be su bject to the jurisdiction of Court at Paonta Sahib only. 12) The mustering in and out of the contractor’s workforce shall be marked a t the entry gate as per the instructions of our P&A Department. 13) Contractor shall all the time indemnify CCI against all claims for Compen sation under the provisions of Workman Compensation Act 1923 or any ot her law for the time being in-force by or in respect of any workmen emplo yed by him. 14) The Corporation will not be liable for any compensation towards any loss to the contractor on account of non-availability of fronts or services due to reason beyond control of the Corporation. 15) In case the contractor n the risk & cost of the contractor. 16) The Management also reserves the right to terminate the contract witho ut any notice if the contractor is found indulging in malpractices. 17) The Corporation shall not be responsible or liable for any credit facilities extended by the contractor to any of his customers. 18) The medical or other facility will be provided by the contractor to their w orkmen at his own cost. 19) All instructions, which shall be issued to contractor by engineer in charg e of Rajban Cement, Factory shall be deemed as part of the contract. 20) The contractor shall have to present himself/ authorized reparative on st ation and one experienced site engineer/supervisor during the entire cour se of work that will be responsible for the execution of work. 21) Any Taxes, duties and levies impose by the Govt. the period of contract shall be applied. The above scope of work and terms & terms and conditio ns has been carefully read by me/us and I/We hereby accept the same.

22) Safety of the tools & tackles, vehicles and the tools , new equipments provid ed by CCI to contractor shall be in the scope of the successful tenderer.
